## Notes

Hidden stress value from -1,000,000 to +1,000,000 with effects at +10,000, +25,000, and +50,000; emotions add or subtract stress; facets such as bravery, stress vulnerability, and anxiety scale it; short-term and long-term memories; tantrums, depression, obliviousness, Harrowed, insanity.
